answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a tide bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the sonnet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
